limitations: Leaf image is an original schematic, not a micrograph, actual specimen or common-scale measurement.

All tables and gas/starch observations are invented study inputs, not experiments conducted for this project. Actual practical/learner and independently calibrated examiner responses remain incomplete.
Only this six-point segment is complete in authored teaching; whole structures-and-functions chapter remains incomplete.

requirements.judgement: Practice identifies carbon source separately from light-energy input and explains chemical-energy transfer without creation of energy.
Worked food-chain case and practice product-use choices connect plant biomass, respiration, storage and consumer supply.
Worked and independent practice both require the word equation and distinguish light/chlorophyll conditions from material reactants.
Both tasks require the net balanced symbol equation; six carbon, twelve hydrogen and eighteen oxygen atoms independently checked on each side.
Matched A/B light comparison and C/D plateau are interpreted without claiming an untested limiter.
Matched B/C carbon-dioxide comparison is assessed with equal light/temperature; near-darkness exception retained in earlier lesson.
Independent C/E/F rate task explains suitable warming and excessive-heat decrease without claiming the invented table proves denaturation or a universal optimum.
Controlled-volume/time comparisons, gas-collection limits and bubble-size caveat are assessed; repeats and lamp-temperature control remain explicit.
Practice asks broad-area/thinness functional links and identifies A cuticle/B epidermis, avoiding gas exchange through the cuticle as the primary route.
C locates palisade cells near incoming light; chloroplast symbols enlarge features without microscope or scale claims.
D spongy tissue/E space/F pore/I guard cells are identified and linked to internal diffusion and pore control; arrow endpoints visually verified.
G xylem and H phloem targets lie inside separate original vein tissues; practice distinguishes incoming water/minerals from organic-solute transport.
Invented omission case and independent claim correction connect magnesium with chlorophyll/light absorption, not glucose supply.
Practice connects nitrate nitrogen with amino-acid/protein production and growth; controlled omission distinguished from symptom-only diagnosis.
O case assesses collected-volume/time rate and glowing-splint evidence for oxygen, with no-plant control/leaks/repeats and net-versus-gross limits.
Practice explains starting starch and reagent controls, teacher-managed water/ethanol/iodine preparation, pigment removal and absence of naked flames; later starch is not an instantaneous rate.
L case interprets covered versus exposed green regions and asks mask-control improvements rather than assuming the cover affects only light.
V case matches pre-recorded green/pale pattern with starch response; independent practice asks the map and repeats, retaining tissue-difference limits.
C case requires an isolated absorber and matching conditions; independent failed-positive-control case rejects an unsupported conclusion and asks leak/humidity controls.
